items.source: A mapped tuple type is typically annotated with @Tuple and its properties/accessors are annotated with @Element(0), @Element(1), ..., @Element(n).
items.translation: 映射元组类型通常使用 @Tuple 进行注解，而其属性/访问器则分别使用 @Element(0), @Element(1), ..., @Element(n) 进行注解。

items.source: Identifies a domain object as Cassandra Tuple. Tuples use ordered fields to map their value to the actual property.
items.translation: 将域对象标识为 Cassandra 元组。元组使用有序字段将其值映射到实际属性。

items.source:
@Tuple
class Address {

        @Element(0) String street;

        @Element(1) @CassandraType(type = Name.ASCII) String city;

        @Element(2) int sortOrder;
}
items.translation:
@Tuple
class Address {

    @Element(0) String street;

    @Element(1) @CassandraType(type = Name.ASCII) String city;

    @Element(2) int sortOrder;
}
